surface_code_cycle_time.source: SQuaRE placeholder derived from trapped-ion native 2Q gate time ~1-3ms (Quantinuum H-series) + measurement overhead; syndrome extraction cycle O(1ms) = 1000µs

platform_class.source: Quantinuum (2025), Helios product announcement and H-series architecture documentation

coherence_time_t2_microseconds.source: Quantinuum H2 T2 coherence > seconds demonstrated; Bruzewicz et al. (2019) review reports T2 > 100s for hyperfine ions in well-shielded traps. DOI: 10.1063/1.5088164
